test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the figure given below the rectangle represents airplanes, the circle represents white and the triangle represents car. The number in each area represents the number of items in that area.

Which of the following statement is NOT correct?

I. Number of white which are car and airplanes both are 9.

II. Number of airplanes which are not car are 24.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3b3a665c63300cc0b74e48711c60d4ebbb269a8a0eb7318c082539d3181fdb0.png]
solution:
**I. Number of white which are car and airplanes both are 9.**

I. Number of white which are cars and airplanes both are 9.

 

In the figure, the number in the intersection of all three shapes is 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29080cf2803a6f4151412dcd61e3453166c6c8f5bce2d68c4fe6ea4d590a62c7.png] 

The number 9 is in the circle and rectangle, but outside the triangle.

So, statement I is **NOT correct.**

**II. Number of airplanes which are not car are 24.**

"Airplanes that are not car" means the numbers inside the rectangle but outside the triangle.

The numbers inside the rectangle that are **not** in the triangle are: 8 + 9 = 17.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29080cf2803a6f4151412dcd61e3453166c6c8f5bce2d68c4fe6ea4d590a62c7.png] 

So, statement I is** NOT correct.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
